headline: AI/ML Engineer at TELUS
about: Passionate about Generative AI, LLMs, and building intelligent systems that solve real-world problems. Currently working at TELUS as an AI/ML Engineer, developing GenAI-powered chatbots, automations, and data pipelines. I enjoy bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI research and production-ready engineering.

positions.title: AI/ML Engineer
positions.description: Building GenAI-powered products and automations for TELUS, including internal chatbots, LLM pipelines, and data-driven solutions.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description: Co-founded a wearable thermal-device startup. Led the prototype from concept to MVP across product R&D, hardware design, and supplier negotiation (±5 °C skin-temperature regulation).

positions.title: Manufacturing Engineer, Co-op
positions.description: Two co-op terms with a study term between them. Led data-driven initiatives that cut material scrap loss by over $100K/year and raised production yield 3%; improved station efficiency 25% through Lean Six Sigma value-stream mapping.
